Who we are

About The New Generation Foundation

Our mission is “Serving life for a future generation.” Our vision is “To provide quality education for a better UGANDA.” We believe education can open opportunities, strengthen communities and help the next generation shape a brighter future.

We welcome individuals and partners who share our commitment to quality education and positive change in Uganda.

Our Mission“Serving life for a future generation.”
